newsitem.title: USA: PC Service Source sees Q3 EPS below Q2's.
newsitem.headline: PC Service Source sees Q3 EPS below Q2's.

text.p: PC Service Source Inc said on Thursday its third-quarter earnings per share would be below its second-quarter performance of $0.16.
The company reported a loss of $1.67 million, or $0.43 a share, in the third quarter last year.

In a statement, Mark Hilz, the president and chief executive, said, "Although the third quarter is not yet complete, the company's revenue and gross margins will show some improvement over the second quarter.

"However, the company's earnings will be below the second quarter's earnings of $0.16 per share. Expenses during the quarter increased too rapidly, but we believe we have made some mid-course adjustments in expenses which will bring them in line with revenue growth during the fourth quarter and beyond.
"We do not see any fundamental change in our business prospects, and we are confident in our ability to continue to execute on our long-term plans."
The company reported earnings of $759,000, or $0.16 a share, on revenues of $26.8 million in the second quarter.
